svg.title: World clock proposal inspired by wald3n.com
svg.desc: Four color-coded clock cards, a schematic world overview with matching pins and selected-place details, and a 24-hour multi-city strip with a selected 30-minute interval.
svg.text: World clock · styling and features from wald3n.com
Illustrative 17 Nov 2026, 10:30 UTC · city colors connect clocks, map pins and comparison rows
Home · flat tinted cards, large tabular time, separate place and country
Full screen · offline Map view and shared comparison strip
Schematic world outline · implementation uses a verified projected asset
Up / Down selects a place · matching list stays available for crowded pins
Standard time · next offset change in details
Country and full name remain explicit; no guessed airport code
Compare · Tue 17 Nov · 18:00 Bangkok · duration 30 min
One interval across every city · exact start/end in details · colors do not replace labels
TV controls: short OK expands · hold configures · Back / Restore returns Home
Design sketch only. Clock icons/shading show stated daytime hours. Map geography is illustrative.
